$comment: What poppy.ax watches for changes, read by scripts/spec-drift.mjs in .github/workflows/spec-drift-watch.yml. poppy.ax follows the Poppy draft that Ora's checks grade, so it watches Ora's published catalog profile, not the spec pages themselves: Ora watches those and moves its profile once it has re-verified a change. The pin must equal `profile` in fixtures/catalog.json (tests/spec-version.test.ts).

issue.title: Ora's Poppy checks moved to a new spec version - update poppy.ax
issue.impact: poppy.ax explains the draft its checker grades, so its pages, its recorded catalog and its draft label now describe a version Ora no longer uses.
issue.todo: Capture `fixtures/catalog.json` again from `GET https://ora.ai/pap/catalog.json` (see fixtures/README.md, and note the date there). Then bring the guide in line with the new draft: the draft line in `content/site.json`, the status in `content/home.json`, the spec lines in `content/learn.mdx` and README.md, the rows under `content/rows/`, and the anchors in `tests/spec-anchors.ts`. `tests/spec-version.test.ts` fails until the draft lines match the recorded catalog. Finally set the pin in `spec-watch.json` to the live value below.
